description: Redfin US home listings in a box around a point, from Redfin's own CSV download: for sale (active, coming soon, pre-market) or sold in the last N days. Row: sale type, sold date, property type, address, ZIP, price, beds, baths, neighborhood, sq ft, lot, year built, days on market, $/sq ft, HOA, status, open house, MLS number and source, coordinates, URL. Up to 350. Some MLS listings/areas (e.g. Seattle) are left out of downloads. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre point (required), e.g. 30.27

radiusKm.description: Half-width of the search box in km, 0.2-25 (default 2)

soldDays.description: For mode=sold: sold within the last N days, 7-1095 (default 90)

type.description: Optional property type: house, condo, townhouse, multifamily, land, other, manufactured, coop

name: realestate_redfin_property_listings
title: Realestate Redfin Property Listings
